notes.title: Wait is over!! Checkmaze Demo will be out on September 28.
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow chess enthusiasts and gamers alike!

I'm incredibly excited to share this moment with you. As a solo developer, I've poured my heart and soul into creating something special, and I can't wait for you to experience it. On September 28, you'll have the chance to play the demo of my chess puzzle game, Checkmaze, as it makes its debut at the Steam Next Festival.

👑 [b]A Chess Puzzle Adventure[/b]; Checkmaze isn't just a chess game; it's an immersive puzzle adventure designed for chess lovers like you. The demo will give you a taste of the unique challenges and mind-bending puzzles that await you.

🌟 [b]Join Me on This Journey[/b]: This is not just a game release; it's the start of a journey we'll embark on together. Your feedback during this festival will be invaluable in shaping the final version of the game.

🗓️ [b]Save the Date[/b]: Mark September 28 on your calendar because that's when you'll get to experience Checkmaze  firsthand. Whether you're a seasoned chess player or new to the world of chess, this is a unique opportunity you won't want to miss.

📢 [b]Share the Excitement[/b]: Help me spread the word to fellow chess enthusiasts and gamers. Together, let's make this demo release a memorable event in the gaming community.

Stay tuned for more updates and details about the Checkmaze. I can't wait to share this chess puzzle adventure with you.

See you on September 28th!

Warm regards,
